api/bifrost/solution_dev/__init__.py.name: Local Solution preview
api/bifrost/solution_dev/__init__.py.description: Groups the pieces that let someone preview a Solution's app on their own machine before publishing it.

api/bifrost/solution_dev/app_select.py.name: Preview app chooser
api/bifrost/solution_dev/app_select.py.description: Picks which app in a Solution the local preview should show.

api/bifrost/solution_dev/function_host.p.name: Local workflow runner
api/bifrost/solution_dev/function_host.p.description: Finds a Solution's workflows and runs them on the spot, so the preview behaves like the real thing.

api/bifrost/solution_dev/proxy.py.name: Local preview server
api/bifrost/solution_dev/proxy.py.description: Serves a Solution's app and its workflows from one local address, standing in for the live platform.

api/bifrost/solution_dev/reload.py.name: Preview refresh
api/bifrost/solution_dev/reload.py.description: Notices when a workflow file changes and reloads it in the running preview.

api/bifrost/solution_dev/scaffold_check..name: Preview setup check
api/bifrost/solution_dev/scaffold_check..description: Spots app project files that are too old for local preview and says what to update.

api/bifrost/solution_dev/session.py.name: Preview sign-in
api/bifrost/solution_dev/session.py.description: Keeps the local preview's temporary sign-in in memory rather than in the browser or a saved password.

api/bifrost/tui/__init__.py.name: Terminal screens
api/bifrost/tui/__init__.py.description: Provides the shared interactive screens the terminal tool shows.

api/bifrost/tui/connection_select.py.name: Connection chooser
api/bifrost/tui/connection_select.py.description: Asks which saved Bifrost connection to use when more than one is available.

api/bifrost/tui/file_select.py.name: File chooser
api/bifrost/tui/file_select.py.description: Lets someone tick which files to send up or fetch down.

api/bifrost/tui/progress.py.name: Transfer progress
api/bifrost/tui/progress.py.description: Shows each file's status and the overall progress while files are sent or fetched.

api/bifrost/tui/sync_app.py.name: Sync review screen
api/bifrost/tui/sync_app.py.description: Shows pending file and entity changes and lets someone choose what to do with each one.

api/bifrost/tui/theme.py.name: Terminal look and feel
api/bifrost/tui/theme.py.description: Gives every terminal screen the same Bifrost colours and styling.

api/bifrost/tui/watch.py.name: Live change monitor
api/bifrost/tui/watch.py.description: Watches a workspace and shows activity as code changes are picked up and sent.
